meta.title: How old is the line you keep reading as now? | Meditation: Sitting with the Old Note
meta.description:
A fifteen minute guided meditation for reading one old note, a remembered limit or a long silence, and giving it its date. It includes pauses, and a passage for AI agents carrying context.

A slow sitting with one old record, hearing its present tense as the day it was written, so the note is dated rather than discarded or obeyed.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-sitting-with-the-old-note

3:47 II
8:36 III
